body.p: Please amend the current claims as follows:

br.br:
1. (Original) A fastening system for attaching a fixture to a monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin, comprising:
a wall portion of the monument which has at least one first fastening element; and
a frame which has at least one second fastening element and which is configured to cover the fixture at least in part in a fastened state;
wherein the first fastening element and the second fastening element are configured to engage with one another and be movable relative to one another in a pre-assembled state, and to fix one another in the fastened state,
wherein the fastened state can be produced in that, in the pre-assembled state, the frame is moved relative to the wall portion in a fastening direction which extends at least substantially parallel to a main extension plane of the wall portion.
2. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the first fastening element and the second fastening element are configured to make it possible to produce the pre-assembled state in that the frame is moved towards the wall portion in an assembly direction which extends substantially perpendicularly to the main extension plane of the wall portion.
3. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein, in the fastened state, at least one of the first fastening element engages behind the second fastening element, or the second fastening element engages behind the first fastening element.
4. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein at least one of the first fastening element or the second fastening element is formed as a hook element.2SVG {EMBED HERE} 0.110.06
5. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the first fastening element and the second fastening element are configured to be released from one another in that, starting from the fastened state, the frame is moved relative to the wall portion counter to the fastening direction.
6. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the frame is configured to retain the fixture, at least in part.
7. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, further comprising a locking unit which, in a locked state, is configured to prevent a release of the fastened state and, in a released state, is configured to allow the release of the fastened state.
8. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 7, wherein the locking unit comprises at least one blocking element which, in the locked state, mechanically prevents a movement of the frame relative to the wall portion.

wherein the frame has a first opening,
wherein the wall portion has a second opening which aligns with the first opening in the fastened state, and
wherein the blocking element extends through the first opening and the second opening, at least in part, in the locked state.
10. (Withdrawn) The fastening system according to The fastening system according to

wherein the blocking element is movable via the actuation member.
11. (Withdrawn) The fastening system according to claim 10, wherein the actuation member is biased into a locking position via a spring element.
12. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein, in the fastened state, the frame covers the first and second fastening elements in an opaque manner.
13. (Original) The fastening system according to The fastening system according to
wherein the wall portion has a plurality of first fastening elements, wherein the frame has a plurality of second fastening elements, and
wherein, in each case, one of the first fastening elements is assigned to one of the second fastening elements respectively.
14. (Original) A monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin comprising a fastening system according to A monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin comprising a fastening system according to
a fixture which is attached via the fastening system.
15. (Original) A method for attaching a fixture to a monument provided for installation in a passenger cabin via a fastening system which includes a wall portion of the monument which has at least one first fastening element, and a frame which has at least one second fastening element and which is configured to retain the fixture, at least in part, in a fastened state, comprising the steps of:
producing a pre-assembled state in which the first fastening element and the second fastening element engage with one another and are movable relative to one another; and
moving the frame in the pre-assembled state relative to the wall portion in a fastening direction which extends at least substantially parallel to a main extension plane of the wall portion to produce the fastened state in which the first fastening element and the second fastening element fix one another.4
16. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the fixture comprises a display.
17. (Original) The fastening system according to claim 1, wherein the passenger cabin is a passenger cabin of an aircraft.5
